payload.title: Luna rewrite suggestions; retire judge from scan
payload.description:
LLM is for rewrites only.

## Scope
- `suggest(request)`: one finding + policy (guidance, rewriteGuidance) + surrounding paragraph → 2–3 options with patch spans, `factVerificationRequired`, `unresolvedQuestions`. No decisions file required.
- Model `gpt-6-luna` by default (configurable); send `max_completion_tokens`, omit `temperature`.
- Remove the OpenAI judge from the `check` path (keep or delete for `compare` per open decision 4).
- Keep the no-fabrication and evasion guards from `editorial_rewrite_options`.

## Done when
- `suggest` passes fixture tests with a fake resolver; `check` makes no LLM calls.
